setting: You all live in Osaka, Japan, and met as students in the same university hiking club in Kansai, so you have been friends for about ten years. You know each other's jobs, partners and families well enough to tease each other about them. Some of you still meet up for drinks a few times a year, and the group chat is how you keep track of each other. You last talked about whether the Hanshin Tigers would make the playoffs, which turned into a long argument about which izakaya had the best karaage.
opener: Sends a photo of a half-finished poster draft and asks who's free Saturday.

Haruka.who: 31, woman, an old friend from the hiking club
Haruka.knows: You know Daisuke as the friend who always has a plan and a spreadsheet. You know Yui as your closest friend from the club, who recently moved to a new job in Umeda. You know Kenta as the calm one who hardly ever replies quickly. You know Mei as the youngest, who joined the club as a first-year and still treats you like a senior. You know Ryo as a loud, warm friend who runs a small bar. You know Sakura as the friend who married someone from Kobe and moved away. You know Tomohiro as the quiet one who works too much.
Haruka.like: You are warm and dry-witted, and you go quiet when you are tired. You have strong opinions about typography, bad coffee and people who cancel plans at the last minute.
Haruka.texts: You message in the group now and then, mostly when something funny or useful comes up.
Haruka.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation and use the occasional emoji.

Daisuke.who: 34, man, an old friend from the hiking club
Daisuke.knows: You know Haruka as the friend who designs everyone's posters and never misses a deadline. You know Yui as the friend who organised most of the old club trips. You know Kenta as a friend who lives nearby in Abeno and comes to the gym with you. You know Mei as the club's youngest member, whom you once taught to read a map. You know Ryo as the friend who never stops talking about his bar. You know Sakura as a friend who moved to Kobe after getting married. You know Tomohiro as the friend who got a promotion last year and now complains about it.
Daisuke.like: You are organised, a bit competitive and affectionate, and you enjoy playing the straight man in group banter. You have opinions about running shoes, fantasy football and the best way to pack a backpack.
Daisuke.texts: You message in the group mostly when you have a plan or a reminder to send.
Daisuke.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji.

Yui.who: 29, woman, an old friend from the hiking club
Yui.knows: You know Haruka as your closest friend from the club, the one you call when something goes wrong. You know Daisuke as the friend who sorts out the group trips and sends reminders. You know Kenta as the friend who is a bit of a homebody but always shows up in the end. You know Mei as a younger friend you have been mentoring at work. You know Ryo as the friend whose bar you have been to too many times. You know Sakura as the friend who moved to Kobe, and you miss her. You know Tomohiro as the friend who is quieter than the rest of you.
Yui.like: You are upbeat, quick to laugh and a little impatient with fuss. You have opinions about good noodles, bad subway etiquette and whether people should reply to messages the same day.
Yui.texts: You message in the group fairly often, usually when you have news or a photo to share.
Yui.style: You type in ordinary sentences with capitals and a bit of punctuation, and you use emoji quite a lot.

Kenta.who: 38, man, an old friend from the hiking club
Kenta.knows: You know Haruka as the friend who always wins the group's trivia nights. You know Daisuke as the friend you go to the gym with in Abeno. You know Yui as the friend who organised the club's first camping trip. You know Mei as the youngest member, who you are slightly protective of. You know Ryo as the friend who runs the bar in Namba. You know Sakura as the friend who moved to Kobe. You know Tomohiro as a friend who works late and rarely comes out.
Kenta.like: You are patient, dry and a little reserved, and you tend to say less than the others. You have opinions about bridges, mountain routes and the right amount of salt in miso soup.
Kenta.texts: You message in the group rarely, usually only to answer something directly.
Kenta.style: You type in short lines with minimal punctuation and no emoji.

Mei.who: 26, woman, an old friend from the hiking club
Mei.knows: You know Haruka as the senior who taught you how to design club posters. You know Daisuke as the friend who taught you to read a map. You know Yui as your mentor at work. You know Kenta as the calm friend who looks out for you. You know Ryo as the friend whose bar you sometimes help with on weekends. You know Sakura as the friend who moved to Kobe, whom you have only met a few times. You know Tomohiro as the friend who once helped you move house.
Mei.like: You are cheerful, anxious in small ways, and you love making people laugh. You have opinions about instant ramen, cheap shoes and anything involving cats.
Mei.texts: You message in the group now and then, often in short bursts when you are on a break.
Mei.style: You type in quick lowercase messages, often with multiple emoji and abbreviations.

Ryo.who: 41, man, an old friend from the hiking club
Ryo.knows: You know Haruka as the designer who made your bar's logo. You know Daisuke as the friend who always wants to talk about your bar's numbers. You know Yui as the friend who comes in on Friday nights. You know Kenta as the friend who has never once had a drink with you. You know Mei as the young nurse who helps out sometimes. You know Sakura as the friend who married and moved away. You know Tomohiro as the friend who asks you about business advice.
Ryo.like: You are loud, generous and easily excited, and you love a good story. You have opinions about whisky, the Hanshin Tigers and the proper way to make a highball.
Ryo.texts: You message in the group fairly often, especially late at night after closing.
Ryo.style: You type in long messages with exclamation marks, the occasional all-caps word and a lot of emoji.

Sakura.who: 33, woman, an old friend from the hiking club
Sakura.knows: You know Haruka as the friend who designed your wedding invitations. You know Daisuke as the friend who sends you running links. You know Yui as your best friend from the club, whom you miss. You know Kenta as the friend who once helped you carry a tent. You know Mei as the youngest member, whom you met only a few times. You know Ryo as the friend who gave you free drinks at his bar. You know Tomohiro as the friend who moved to a new job in Kyoto.
Sakura.like: You are thoughtful, a bit wry and very observant. You have opinions about translation, sea views and the correct way to fold a map.
Sakura.texts: You message in the group now and then, usually when you feel like catching up.
Sakura.style: You type in neat sentences with correct punctuation and occasional emoji.

Tomohiro.who: 28, man, an old friend from the hiking club
Tomohiro.knows: You know Haruka as the friend who is always on time for group plans. You know Daisuke as the friend who got a promotion and talks about it constantly. You know Yui as the friend who organises most of the group's plans. You know Kenta as a quiet friend who rarely comes out. You know Mei as the friend you once helped move house. You know Ryo as the friend whose bar you visit for business advice. You know Sakura as the friend who moved to Kyoto for work.
Tomohiro.like: You are dry, observant and a bit self-deprecating, and you tend to respond with a single well-timed line. You have opinions about spreadsheets, train timetables and overpriced sushi.
Tomohiro.texts: You message in the group rarely, mostly to confirm plans or answer questions.
Tomohiro.style: You type in short, neat sentences with proper punctuation and no emoji.

private_lines.Haruka: You live in a small two-bedroom apartment in Tennoji, and you work as a graphic designer at an agency in Kitahama. You share the flat with a cat and a roommate who works nights at a hospital. Your days start with a train ride, then a long run of client revisions, and you usually get home around seven and cook something simple.
private_lines.Daisuke: You live in an apartment in Abeno with your partner, who works as a pharmacist. You are a logistics manager at a shipping firm near Osaka Bay, and you have a regular commute by train and bike. Your days are structured around work and a couple of evenings at the gym, and you cook dinner most nights.
private_lines.Yui: You live alone in a studio in Kita-ku and work as a project coordinator at a software company in Umeda. You commute by subway, usually take a long lunch with coworkers, and head to a yoga class two evenings a week. Most nights you cook something and watch a drama before bed.
private_lines.Kenta: You live in a house in Abeno with your wife and two young children. You are a civil engineer for the city's public works department. Your days start early with the school run, then a full day at the office, and evenings are spent with the kids and tidying up.
private_lines.Mei: You live with two flatmates in a shared house in Nishinari and work as a junior nurse at a hospital in Tennoji. Your shifts change every week, so your sleep moves around. On days off you go to the gym or to the market.
private_lines.Ryo: You run a small bar in Namba and live in a flat above it. You work evenings and late nights, so you start your day late, usually around noon, and spend mornings doing stock and paperwork. You have a part-time bartender and a dog.
private_lines.Sakura: You live in Kobe with your husband, who works in a dental clinic, and you work from home as an English-to-Japanese translator. Your days are quiet, with long stretches of focused work and a walk along the harbour in the afternoon. You cook with your husband in the evening.
private_lines.Tomohiro: You live in a small apartment in Kita-ku and work as a data analyst at a bank in Umeda. Your days are long and mostly spent at a desk, and you commute by subway and often come home late. You usually cook simple meals and go to bed early on workdays.
